Windows · Your setup · LumaLatch 0.2.0 · Picture guide

Windows setup.
Start to finish.

Tailscale and Jellyfin already work. These first ten pages cover Windows only. Mac users: jump straight to page 11.

Download these two packages

ComputerWhat to download
Main Windows PC
100.76.133.88		LumaLatch-0.2.0-Windows-x64.zip
Contains LumaLatch.exe and its runtime.
Windows laptopLumaLatch-0.2.0-Guest.zip
Contains the Chrome extension. Laptop 1 can still create the party using this ZIP.

Use Google Chrome. Keep Tailscale connected. Choose one laptop as the party host (Laptop 1); the other is the guest (Laptop 2), whatever its operating system. No Node.js installation needed.

Windows walkthrough · LumaLatch picture guide1 / 19

Windows · Windows · Do once on each Windows computer

Extract the ZIP first.

  1. Open File Explorer (the folder icon). Click Downloads. Find the ZIP from page 1: Windows-x64 on the main PC; Guest on a Windows laptop.
  2. Right-click the ZIP → Extract All…. Click Browse…, choose Documents, then click Select Folder → Extract. If a LumaLatch folder already exists, choose a new folder name to avoid replacing it.
  1. Open the extracted LumaLatch folder. If there is another LumaLatch folder inside it, open that too. On the main PC, double-click LumaLatch.exe. On a laptop, continue to page 4; the Guest ZIP has no executable.

Keep the extracted folder in Documents. Do not run from inside the ZIP. Chrome will continue using its extension folder after installation.

Windows walkthrough · LumaLatch picture guide2 / 19

Windows · Main PC only · Repeat before each watch session

Start LumaLatch on the main PC.

Open the extracted LumaLatch.exe on the Windows PC with address 100.76.133.88. This PC can relay the party while both people watch on their laptops.

  1. Find the green Status line. It should say Ready to start on 100.76.133.88. If needed, scroll up in the launcher to its step 2 and click Recheck readiness.
  2. Leave Port at 8787. Click Start server (launcher step 4). Wait for the status/log to report that it is running. The Stop server button becomes available.
  3. Click Copy signaling address. Both laptops will use this exact address:
ws://100.76.133.88:8787/party

Keep this app open and the main PC awake. Closing it or clicking Stop server disconnects all parties.

Skip the launcher’s installation buttons: Tailscale is already ready. Its step 3 installs Chrome’s extension only if someone also watches on this main PC; laptop extension installation happens on page 4.

The portable Windows launcher is unsigned. If Windows blocks it, verify the supplied ZIP checksum and consult your administrator or trusted organizer. Keep Windows protection enabled.

Windows walkthrough · LumaLatch picture guide3 / 19

Windows · Each Windows laptop · Do once

Add LumaLatch to Chrome.

Open Chrome. Click the top address bar. Type chrome://extensions, then press Enter.

  1. Turn on Developer mode at the top right.
  2. Click Load unpacked at the top left.
  3. In the folder window, open Documents → LumaLatch → extension. Select the extension folder, then click Select Folder.

Success: a LumaLatch card appears; its on/off switch is on. Repeat on the other Windows laptop if needed.

Windows walkthrough · LumaLatch picture guide4 / 19

Windows · Both laptops · Enable this Jellyfin site once

Allow LumaLatch on Jellyfin.

In Chrome, open the dashboard you already use:

http://100.76.133.88:8096/web/index.html#/home

Stay on the Jellyfin tab. Sign in with your usual Jellyfin account if asked.

  1. Click Chrome’s Extensions puzzle icon near the top right. Click LumaLatch in its list.
  2. In the popup below, click Enable on this Jellyfin site. Approve Chrome’s site-access prompt if shown.

Success: “Enabled here. Open a video to start.”

If needed, refresh Jellyfin once with Chrome’s reload button. Repeat on the other laptop. You normally only grant site access once per Chrome profile.

Windows walkthrough · LumaLatch picture guide5 / 19

Windows · Both laptops · Begin each session

Open the same video. Connect.

  1. Agree on the exact movie or episode. On each laptop, open that item in Jellyfin and click its Play button to enter the video player.
  2. Use the same version if Jellyfin offers several. Pause while setting up. The LumaLatch panel appears near the bottom right.

1 · Check this address

Signaling server must read:

ws://100.76.133.88:8787/party

Replace it if different.

2 · Click Connect

Do this on both laptops. The main PC’s server must already be running.

The addresses have different jobs. http://…:8096 opens Jellyfin. ws://…:8787/party goes in LumaLatch’s Signaling server field.

Windows walkthrough · LumaLatch picture guide6 / 19

Windows · Laptop 1 only · This person controls the party

Create the party. Share the invite.

After connecting on page 6, click Create Party. Laptop 1 is now the party host; the main PC continues running the server.

1 · Check Host

The badge says Host. The status says “Party created. Share the invite.”

2 · Copy invite

Click Copy invite. Paste the whole link into your private chat with the person on Laptop 2.

Paste with Ctrl+V.

3 · Leave permissions off

Keep all three boxes unticked for your first session. Laptop 1 controls play, pause and seeking.

You can grant controls later; see page 10.

Keep Laptop 1’s Jellyfin player tab open. Leaving the party, closing that tab or disconnecting ends this party. A new session needs a fresh invite.

If copying the invite fails

Privately send Laptop 2 the Signaling server address and the complete Party ID displayed in your panel. They can enter both fields manually. Do not reuse the example ID in this guide.

Windows walkthrough · LumaLatch picture guide7 / 19

Windows · Laptop 2 only · Join the party from Laptop 1

Open the invite. Join Party.

  1. Copy the whole invite link from your chat. Paste it into Chrome’s address bar, then press Enter. Sign in to Jellyfin if asked.
  2. Open the same exact movie or episode as Laptop 1. Click Play to enter the player. If Chrome blocks playback, press Play once yourself.
  3. The invite should fill Signaling server and Party ID. Click Connect if not already connected.

1 · Check Party ID

Use Laptop 1’s full ID. The invite usually fills it.

2 · Click Join Party

Do not click Create Party. That would make a different room.

If fields are blank

Login or navigation may lose the invite. Open the original invite again after signing in, then reopen the same media.

Or ask Laptop 1 for the server address and Party ID. Paste them into the matching fields, then Connect and Join Party.

Success: the badge changes to Guest and the status says “Joined party.” The next page shows that result.

Laptop 2 does not start a server. The main PC runs that. Each laptop streams its own copy from Jellyfin.

Windows walkthrough · LumaLatch picture guide8 / 19

Windows · Both laptops · Check once, then watch

Check Guest. Test a pause.

3 · Check Guest

Laptop 2 says Guest. Laptop 1 says Host.

4 · Check Joined party

Laptop 2’s status confirms it joined.

Try this together

  1. On Laptop 1, press Jellyfin’s Play.
  2. Check Laptop 2 starts too. If autoplay is blocked, press Play once there.
  3. On Laptop 1, press Pause. Check both players pause.
  4. Resume on Laptop 1.

Finish: Laptop 1 clicks Leave Party. When everyone is done, click Stop server on the main PC. Next time, start the server and create a new party.

Windows · Keep this page handy

If a step gets stuck.

Connection check: on the laptop, open http://100.76.133.88:8787/health in Chrome while the main PC’s server is running.

Let your friend control playback, if wanted

Untick a permission to remove it. Subtitles and quality are separate permissions; support depends on Jellyfin’s native menus.

Jellyfin works, but LumaLatch cannot connect
They use different ports. Confirm the main PC’s LumaLatch server is running on 8787. Try the health address above. If it fails, ask the network administrator to check access to that port; keep firewalls enabled.
No LumaLatch card or player panel
At chrome://extensions, confirm LumaLatch is enabled. Load the extracted extension folder. Enable it from the Jellyfin tab (page 5), refresh and open a video. The dashboard alone has no player panel.
Chrome or Windows blocks installation
Managed devices may block unpacked extensions. The Windows launcher is unsigned. Verify the download checksum and ask your administrator or trusted organizer if blocked; keep protection enabled.

Pictures: actual app controls and labelled OS illustrations. Demo controls use local test media. Network latency and buffering affect synchronization.

Every ZIP includes this PDF and START-HERE.html. Keep the extracted files together. SHA256SUMS.txt supplies ZIP integrity hashes; host packages include third-party licenses.

Mac · Your Mac · Complete walkthrough

Mac setup.
Start here.

Your Mac already reaches Jellyfin through Tailscale. Follow these pages in order; no Windows setup steps on your Mac.

Download only this ZIP on your Mac

LumaLatch-0.2.0-Guest.zip

Despite its filename, this ZIP lets your Mac create or join a party. It includes the Chrome extension and this guide. No Mac server runtime, Terminal commands or .exe needed.

Choose one laptop as the party host (Laptop 1). The other is the guest (Laptop 2). Either may be a Mac or a Windows computer.

Before continuing: ask the main PC’s owner to start its LumaLatch server and leave it running. On your Mac, open the connection check; a reachable server returns {"ok":true}. Jellyfin working alone does not confirm this separate server is running.

Mac walkthrough · LumaLatch picture guide11 / 19

Mac · Mac laptop · Do once on each Mac

Unzip. Keep the folder.

The main PC runs the server. Your Mac laptop only needs the Guest ZIP and Chrome.

  1. Download LumaLatch-0.2.0-Guest.zip using the supplied link.
  2. Open Finder (the blue face icon). Click Downloads in its sidebar. Double-click the ZIP. macOS creates a LumaLatch folder nearby.
  3. Drag the whole LumaLatch folder into Documents in Finder’s sidebar. If that name is already used, rename the new folder first; keep the old folder intact.

Check what is inside

Double-click Documents → LumaLatch. You should see an extension folder, Quick-Start.pdf, START-HERE.html and READ-ME-FIRST.txt.

No server package needed on this Mac. Do not look for an .exe or open a Terminal window on your Mac. Next, add the extension to Chrome on page 13.

If Chrome is not already on this laptop, install it from google.com/chrome. Safari cannot load this extension.
